style: Soft cute 3D clay render, rounded chubby toy-like shapes, pastel jade green, cream and soft gold, soft upper-left studio lighting, fixed front orthographic camera.
layout: One species per sheet, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows. Top-left sprout, top-right seedling, bottom-left adult, bottom-right ripe. Same camera and physical scale across stages. Small warm brown soil mound, no pot, generous margins, all objects fully inside their quadrants. No text, labels, lines, scenery, watermark or baked glow.
background: Transparent background; if an explicitly authorized fallback cannot provide alpha, use flat pure magenta #FF00FF, no floor or external shadow.
output: docs/art-raw/crop-<id>.png -> assets/crop-<id>-0..3.webp, common scale per species, max 176x200
